title: Reconstruction Project Management Memo: Change Processing Deduction on Removals
content:
A removal from a Reconstruction contract after the work has been planned carries the company's change processing deduction, a fixed deduction of the deductive change order.

**Rule.**

- When construction on the contract has started, the field-remeasure deduction of $95.00.
- When the permit has cleared but construction has not started, the plan-update deduction of $45.00.
- Before the permit clears there is no processing deduction.

The stage is read from the contract record on the signing date: construction has started when a construction start date is recorded on or before that date; the permit has cleared when a permit cleared date (the permit issued or the no-permit determination recorded) is recorded on or before that date.

## Stage table

| Permit cleared | Construction started | Processing deduction |
|---|---|---|
| yes | yes | $95.00 field remeasure |
| yes | no | $45.00 plan update |
| no | no | none |

**Example (hypothetical).** A contract in permitted status whose permit cleared on the 2nd of a month and on which construction has not started: a deductive change order signed on the 12th carries $45.00. After construction starts on the 20th, a deductive change order signed that day or later carries $95.00. A contract still in signed status, with no permit cleared, carries none.
